_comment: Every entry runs a REAL command against a LIVE Blender session and draws the
captured stdout/stderr/exit code into a PNG. Nothing here is hand-written
output: if the CLI changes, re-running the renderer changes the screenshots.
Requirements: Blender running with the bridge started on 127.0.0.1:9876,
the bpy-bridge CLI installed (pip install -e .), and Pillow available.

screenshots.caption: bpy-bridge status  —  the live scene, not a fixture
